data.title: Deutsche Bank and JPMorgan expand Ethereum use ... | Pluang
data.description: Deutsche Bank is launching an Ethereum-based digital asset custody service for institutional clients in Germany, covering assets like ETH, BTC, and euro stablecoins, pending regulatory approval. Meanwhile, JPMorgan has moved its JPM Coin to Ethereum's mainnet, enabling on-chain payments and peer-to-peer transfers within the Ethereum ecosystem. These moves signal growing institutional adoption of Ethereum for liquidity and asset tokenization, offering more regulated access to crypto for large investors. Key developments to watch include Deutsche Bank's regulatory approval and service expansion across Europe, and JPMorgan's shift of transactions to public Ethereum networks.
